description:
Create a valid EN 16931 e-invoice (UBL or CII XML) from JSON.

Input: `invoice` is a JSON object keyed on EN 16931 Business Terms, the same
schema as `POST /v1/generate`, at most 4 MB. Main fields: `syntax` ("ubl"
default, or "cii"), `flavor` ("en16931" default, or "xrechnung", which
requires `buyer_reference`, the Leitweg-ID BT-10, and `payment_iban`),
`invoice_number`,
`issue_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `currency`, `seller`, `buyer`, `lines`,
`tax_breakdown`, `totals`. invowerk writes your amounts as given. It does not
compute or correct them. Input that breaks an EN 16931 or XRechnung rule
returns an error naming each rule, e.g. BT-112 = BT-109 + BT-110 (BR-CO-15).
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, amounts go up to 999,999,999.99.

Returns `xml`, `syntax`, `flavor` and `self_validation`. invowerk checks the
XML before answering and never returns an invalid document. Invalid input, or
XML that fails the check, returns an error, as does a busy (`engine_busy`) or
overrunning (`engine_timeout`) generate.

Credits: 5 per call.

invoice.description: The invoice as a JSON object keyed on EN 16931 Business Terms, the schema of POST /v1/generate and of parse_invoice's `model`: syntax, flavor, invoice_number, issue_date, currency, seller, buyer, lines, tax_breakdown, totals.

name: generate_invoice
title: Create an e-invoice from JSON
